name: Wenchang Tower
description: Wenchang Pagoda, also known as Wenfeng Pagoda and Wenbi Pagoda, is a sacred pagoda in people's hearts. Historically, where the Wenchang Tower was built, there were often talented people who won the imperial examinations and gold medals in high schools. Therefore, people believed that it could gather spiritual energy and bless their studies. The name Wenchang comes from "Wenquxing" and "Wenchang Emperor", which represents prosperous writing and has the function of promoting writing and promoting nobleness in Kanyuology. The Pinku Wenchang Tower is a mascot that promotes studies, fame, and career. Placing it in the Wenchang position will help academic progress and official luck.
